qualification: observed positive monthly history >=4 months at issue; current metadata never used to upgrade qualification; unseen history UNKNOWN
new_products: retain core membership and baseline; not trained/scored as established B1/B2/B3 outputs
history_missing: missing daily grid values remain NaN; training rows with incomplete lags dropped; prediction requires latest consecutive 56 known days; retain failures
truth_missing: any missing/invalid source day makes that target window UNKNOWN; zero requires explicit records
fit: global across all eligible established shop-SPU series, not just core; recursive one-day labels; every fitted daily label ends on/before available cutoff; no tuning on incomplete 60-day validation labels
b2: same model with lag-1 source session-events and order/session ratio; future exogenous values frozen to pre-cutoff 28-day means; not future actuals or unique visitors
b3: B2 plus lag-1 ad spend/clicks/orders, fixed same pre-cutoff extrapolation; ratios never row-averaged
side_controls: monthly V4/A16 not ranked as exact daily-window forecasts; frozen sources and archives retained
negative_predictions: clip to zero for all models, preserve floating values until scoring
metric_denominators: fixed core list; model-available and common B1/B2/B3 subsets explicitly secondary, never redefine core universe
acceptance: no equivalence of WAPE and product target; all-window item errors required, all-store and new coverage gaps preclude complete PASS
